name: Last Gasp
subtitle: Don't draw the last line
description: Hangman with no turns. Somebody sets the word — typed by hand, not picked from a list — and everybody else races for it: any letter, any moment, whoever's fastest gets it. Land one and you alone get a two-second window to keep going, chaining hit after hit for bigger points each time. Miss, and the stickman takes another line — six and he's finished, and whoever drew the last one forfeits everything they earned that word. Free-For-All is every player for themselves; Teams has your side suggest and vote on a word for the other team to crack. Set teams right in the lobby, then play against bots, share one screen, or take up to seven friends online.
controls: Type a word when it's yours to set. Otherwise, tap any letter the instant you think of it — first correct guess wins it.
